predecessors.name: Federated Republic of Mexico
predecessors.text: the Baja California peninsula, whose independence Walker's men proclaimed on 3 November 1853

successors.name: Federated Republic of Mexico
successors.text: the peninsula, back under Mexico after Walker's retreat

ledger.x: 3 November 1853: William Walker proclaims the Republic of Lower California at La Paz.
November 1853: Walker claims the whole peninsula.
21 January 1854: the Republic of Lower California becomes part of Walker's Republic of Sonora.
8 May 1854: the end of Walker's Sonora presidency.
May 1854: the peninsula is Mexican again.

wars.name: Walker's filibuster expedition to Baja California and Sonora
wars.outcome: The filibusters take La Paz (3 November 1853), move their headquarters to Ensenada, proclaim the Republic of Sonora (21 January 1854) and are forced to retreat by supply, aridity and Mexican resistance; Walker ends his presidency on 8 May 1854, surrenders to…

certainty.note: A claim over a peninsula of which the filibusters held two towns; no frontier line exists.
